top_reply.author: @funnyspoof
top_reply.text:
No, Even though some overlap, each platform trains their AI differently. Depending upon your goals just like Dan says You can use them synergistically together. This includes copying and answer from one (ie: Gemini or chatGPT) and pasting it into another one (ie: grok or Claude)and asking it to improve the answer. 

Because this is so helpful and I use it so often, I created a local framework of scripts to help me do this automatically through OAuth and/or API. 

If this is of interest to you, consider using openrouter's free models 😮

Reply to my comment with the word framework if you would like me to share what I've built. I expect I'll be releasing it within the next few weeks.

top_reply.author: @funnyspoof
top_reply.text:
I'm general ai is better than most humans at general knowledge and sometimes in capabilities, however what's available to the public is designed to fall short in continued awareness and short term and remembering long term, and too often drawing the wrong conclusions or making mistakes. 

Private ai largely resolves all the issues (but that's not shared with the general public)
